name: Unfinished apartment frame (abandoned)
description: Abandoned and overgrown: Unfinished three-storey apartment block, 22 x 11 m frame (28 x 14 m with stairs and scaffold): in-situ concrete slabs on columns and downstand beams, ground floor, two upper floors and a roof slab all walkable; a precast switchback stair outside each end with temporary tube rails on the landings only; part-built blockwork on some bays with window openings and precast lintels; column stubs and starter bars on the roof, bars sticking out of the west slab edge; adjustable steel props and formwork under the roof slab in one corner; stacked formwork panels and bar on the roof; a boarded tube scaffold along the front face; pallets of blocks on the ground slab. Open frame: no doors, never furnished.
notes: Unfinished frame: slabs use non-floor materials so the interior system never furnishes or finishes it; nav rooms per level and stair storey.
